question_notes_append.includes_gas: VRF-9 (R1): 'factory charged with first charge of refrigerant', 'initial charge' or 'full charge' means the gas charge IS included -- answer Yes (the own-row rule still decides).
question_notes_append.includes_comm: VRF-9 (R2): cables for a BMS interface / BACnet / Modbus / third-party integration are NOT this unit's communication cable -- never answer Yes from them.
question_notes_append.includes_frame: VRF-9 (R3): civil pedestal supports, a suitable foundation or a plinth are civil work, NOT the MS frame -- never answer Yes from them.
question_notes_append.scope: VRF-9 (S4): an installation wording at ANY level above the row (a grandparent heading's note, the top heading) wins over a supply-only reading of a nearer note -- answer 'Supply + installation'.
question_notes_append.capacity: VRF-9 (S7): a fresh-air (TFA) unit takes the capacity the row states (CFM / TR, else HP) -- copy it.
question_notes_append.item: VRF-9 (S9 / S10): a row that only charges / tops up refrigerant gas is 'Refrigerant Gas Filling (R-410)'; a row for the outdoor units' MS base frame / stand / structure is 'MS frame / stand for ODU' -- never leave the item out.
question_notes_append.set_contents_as_written: VRF-9 (S8): copy what one Set holds even when it is only 'Liquid and Gas considered as one Set'.
